g.text: Spawn, back, random, requests, and your server access.
Spawn and Back are one click. Random
teleport lands you in a ring around spawn,
inside the world border, never in lava and
never near a raid; pick another server and
The ACCESS list shows each server that needs
access, your state there, and the token that
sells it. The HUD layout button cycles the
icons above your hotbar between Row, Strip
